label: after
stuck_definition: Speed below 30cm/s with target above 150cm/s, or any continuous stop over 5s; commanded short yields separately counted as stationary time.
metric_definition: Pairwise order exchanges require +/-250 cm longitudinal clearance and 1s confirmation, counted after 5s. Collision episodes are per-kart starts of non-ground swept contacts, separated by 0.5s. Off-track episodes test nine points of the collider footprint against the union of actual paired-edge corridor quads, with 0.3s confirmation. Local tangent-plane excess is retained separately because it is inaccurate at sharp bends. Player uses the existing opt-in AI diagnostic driver.
